observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same image: a black rectangular console wrapped in clear plastic, with a coiled black cable and a UK-style 3-pin plug on top.
The console has 'PS4' printed on the bottom right corner of the front face.
A black DualShock 4 controller is placed in front of the console.
The console appears to be a PS4 Slim model based on its size and shape.
The UK plug suggests it is designed for 230V/50Hz power, which is standard in the UK but not in Nigeria (which uses 220-240V, 50Hz — compatible, but plug type differs).
No power adapter or HDMI cable is visible.
The console is wrapped in plastic, suggesting it is being sold as 'used' but possibly still sealed or minimally used.
No screen or internal components are shown.
No games or game discs are visible.
